async function obtainSixRawCopper(bot) {
    // The function checks if the inventory already contains at least six raw copper items; if so, it stops. Otherwise, it attempts to find and equip a suitable pickaxe. It first searches for nearby copper ore blocks and mines them until the required amount is reached or no more are found nearby. If the goal is not met, it explores the area to locate any copper ore. Finally, it equips a pickaxe again and mines the necessary amount of copper ore to ensure six raw copper items are obtained.
}
